64.reason: led 1018-981-1 over 2000 games at 10000 nodes and 64-35-1 over 100 games at 250 ms, but increased depth-five root regret from 1079 to 1300 across 50 random positions; held for accuracy despite promising self-play

128.name: topology-position correction history

512.name: reverse futility pruning
512.reason: a 100-game paired 50000-node screen drew 50-50 and increased average depth from 8.35 to 8.74; promising efficiency evidence, but no strength gain yet

1024.name: razoring
1024.reason: the 250 ms screen gained no depth, reduced average NPS, and changed three of four moves

2048.name: ProbCut
2048.reason: a 100-game paired 50000-node screen lost 49-51 and reached lower average depth than baseline (7.66 versus 7.86); its 4% higher NPS did not represent more useful search

4096.name: history pruning
4096.reason: gained no aggregate depth at either screen and changed a move at one second

8192.name: multi-cut
8192.reason: a 100-game paired 50000-node screen drew 50-50 but reached lower average depth than baseline (7.96 versus 8.59); its 4% higher NPS did not improve useful search

16384.name: singular extension
16384.reason: lost two aggregate plies at 250 ms and changed two of four moves

32768.name: forced-defense extension
32768.reason: gained no aggregate depth at either screen and changed a move at one second

65536.name: left-right canonical transposition table
65536.reason: parity and random mirror reuse passed; constant-time wall reflection was retained, but the optimized 250 ms screen lost two aggregate plies, reduced median NPS by 32%, and changed one of four timed moves

131072.name: all-shortest-route selective walls
131072.reason: demand-driven route unions fixed the depth regression and reduced the 250 ms median-NPS cost from 43% to 23%; a 42-position depth-3 audit reduced maximum root regret from 151 to 100 and fixed the 151-unit miss, but two of four timed moves still changed, so fixed-node and paired strength evidence are required

262144.name: auxiliary topology distance cache v3
262144.reason: revision one reduced 250 ms median NPS by 27%; delayed admission and cheaper reconstruction still reduced one-second median NPS by 11%, changed two of four preferred moves, and produced no aggregate depth gain; a topology-centered position design requires a new experiment identity

524288.name: conservative adaptive late-move reductions
524288.reason: matched baseline regret exactly across 50 depth-five positions but reduced the four-position 250 ms average depth from 8.0 to 7.5 and changed two timed moves

1048576.name: guarded adaptive late-move reductions
1048576.reason: reduced depth-five root regret from 1079 to 1059, led 264-236 at 10000 nodes and 62-38 at 250 ms, but both SPRTs remain inconclusive and representative benchmarks gained no completed depth

dynamicRootQueue.decision: The predicted-first null-window prototype is much faster on the opening, but deterministic tie selection requires native ordering metadata and efficiency varies by position; keep production scheduling unchanged.

wasmSimd.reason: Three-trial 250 ms medians produced the same 399582-byte artifact, reduced average depth from 8.00 to 7.75, and reduced average NPS from 1457446 to 1426536
